scope: Rerender the DROID ego-to-third-person demos with explicit condition and target labels
summary: The direct Python rerender entry point was interrupted after the shared local Python environment stalled during dependency import. It produced no video and was replaced by a deterministic transparent-overlay route.
evidence: The process remained inside Python import file reads for more than three minutes while several unrelated local pytest processes showed the same shared-environment stall.
The interrupted entry point produced no final directory or published media before termination.
The original verified 20260811T135000Z experiment and its published videos remained intact throughout the failed attempt.
lessons: A purely visual provenance-label change should have a deterministic media-overlay fallback that does not depend on importing OpenCV.
Failed rerender attempts must be retained even when a later fallback produces the requested artifact.
limitations: This attempt produced no labeled video and is not delivery evidence.
next_actions: Render one transparent 1280x720 label overlay and apply it to the already verified videos with ffmpeg.
